description: This file defines the interface PayloadBuilder, which provides methods for constructing Payload instances by setting various properties such as value, extra, status, revision, timestamp, metadata, and fields. It serves as a builder pattern for creating Payload objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.protocoladapter package.

classes.name: PayloadBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining a builder for creating Payload instances with various customizable fields such as value, extra, status, revision, timestamp, metadata, and fields.

methods.name: withValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the payload, replacing any previously set value.

methods.name: withExtra
methods.description: Adds extra information to the payload, potentially enriching the main value.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code of the payload, either via HttpStatusCode or integer.

methods.name: withRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision number of the payload.

methods.name: withTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for the payload.

methods.name: withMetadata
methods.description: Attaches metadata to the payload; available since version 1.3.0.

methods.name: withFields
methods.description: Defines specific fields within the payload, either via JsonFieldSelector or a string.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the Payload object based on the set properties.
